text: 下面进入小作文 01 · 建议信：图书馆设施与自习服务优化答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：表明写信人身份与核心来意。

As a senior student at this university who spends considerable time reading in the library, I am writing this letter with the aim of putting forward some constructive suggestions to improve the current facilities and services.
加分替换词：putting forward suggestions 替换为 offering constructive proposals。
第二段：提出三条具有针对性与可操作性的具体建议。
In the first place, it is exceedingly advisable that the administration prolong the opening hours during examination weeks to accommodate students' intense revision schedules.
核心句型：虚拟语气 It is exceedingly advisable that sb. (should) do sth.。
It is exceedingly advisable that the administration prolong the opening hours.
第三段：礼貌致谢并期待管理部门答复。
Thank you for your time and favorable consideration of my recommendations, and I am genuinely looking forward to your earliest reply at your convenience.
考场名言点睛：千里之行，始于足下。
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
